patch.value: GH-1716: pm files and pm docs --add silently replace an existing link's note, and the receipt reports it as a plain change

GH-1716 (filed 2026-11-12). pm files id --add path=P,note=N2 on a path already linked with a different note silently replaces the earlier note, and pm docs --add does the same. The output reports changed true and mutation_receipt changed_count 1, which also describes adding a new link, so an agent cannot tell that it overwrote another agent's rationale; the first note survives only in history, which pm get does not show. Found during a multi-agent review round, where an orchestrator lost the implementer's notes on two paths and had to revert the writes and use a comment instead. Proposal from the issue: refuse an --add whose path and scope already exist with a different non-empty note with a conflict code (for example link_note_conflict) naming the existing note and offering --replace-note (today's behaviour) or --append-note (joins the notes); keep an identical or note-less repeat an idempotent no-op reporting changed false; and make the receipt distinguish added, note_replaced and unchanged per link, for files and docs and the SDK link operations alike.

An --add whose path and scope are linked with a different non-empty note is refused with a link conflict code that names the existing note and keeps it; --append-note joins the notes and --replace-note keeps today's behaviour, each recorded in history as one operation; Repeating an identical --add reports changed false, and receipts distinguish added, note_replaced and unchanged per link for files, docs and the SDK
